column1: # Dependency register (C23, row 371): one row per direct dependency of every workspace crate, detached crate and package.json,
# plus the cargo-installed tool dx. Read by scripts/check-dependency-register.sh, which fails on a declared dependency with no
# row, a row with no declaration, a version that differs from the lock (a bump re-opens the row: re-evaluate, then update
# version and evidence_date together) and an exception whose exception_end is before today.
# Columns: version is the resolved lock version (comma-separated where the locks differ); outcome is keep, lift, drop or
# exception (a D6 exception, owner-granted, needs exception_end); reach is the strongest way the code touches the user or
# the machine (compile-time-code, unsafe, untrusted-input, fs-network, none); scope is who compiles or runs it
# (user-closure, site, cli, lab, dev, tool); evidence_date is the date the row was last evaluated.
